packageRules.description: Keep the Chainguard builder (python:latest-dev) and runtime (python:latest) in lockstep, so the venv copied from the builder always matches the runtime Python. A digest that changes the Python minor version fails the image smoke test and needs a manual requires-python bump.
garminconnect must follow Garmin's sign-in changes within days, so it skips the cooldown; it handles the Garmin password, so a person merges it, in a PR of its own.
